To the Editor, I am writing in response to your article of last Thursday concerning the proposed closure of the Harbour Road Library. While I appreciate the paper's coverage, the piece stated that attendance had fallen by 30% over three years, and I believe this is incorrect. According to the council's own report, which I have in front of me, the figure was 13%, and it was driven almost entirely by the six months the building was shut for repairs. I would also like to point out that the story did not mention the after school program, which serves around 90 children every week. I would be grateful if a correction could be printed.
